product.name: Vertiv Liebert PSI5 UPS - 1000VA 900W 120V 1U Line Interactive AVR Rack Mount UPS 0.9 Power Factor
product.description: The Vertiv Liebert PSI5 1kVA UPS is designed to protect and extend the life of your electronic devices in school, home and office. This 1U rack mount UPS offers cost-effective protection from downtime and damage caused by power outages, brownouts, sags, surges or noise interference. Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR) extends battery life and safeguards critical equipment. Voltage regulation is from 83 to 159 VAC without using the battery. With advanced pure sine wave output, this line interactive UPS ensures availability of critical IT applications like network closets and small data centers. This battery backup allows orderly shutdown of critical equipment. It takes less than 6 milliseconds transfer time to battery. Add an optional Vertiv Liebert Unity communication card and remotely monitor up to 50 UPS systems through the free Vertiv Trellis Power Insight Application.
